summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, announcing a 4.3% increase in its quarterly dividend to US$0.06 per share, payable September 15, 2026, to shareholders of record August 31, 2026. The forward annualized dividend rises to US$0.24 per share from US$0.23, marking the fifth consecutive annual increase since its May 2021 IPO. The company is a precious metals streaming and royalty firm with 242 assets. No advisors are mentioned. Watch for continued dividend growth as a capital-return signal.
